name: Médecins Sans Frontières (Doctors Without Borders)
summary: An independent medical humanitarian organisation running hospitals, clinics, feeding centres, vaccination and outbreak responses in about 70 countries, mostly in conflicts and epidemics.

lines.label: Medical care in crises
lines.source: https://www.msf.org/sites/default/files/2026-07/MSF_International_Financial_Report_2025.pdf (combined accounts 2025, euros): programmes 1,579,640k + programme support 316,400k, less relief distributions (653,300 families × our 45 euros, 29,399k) and search and rescue (3,152k), plus the net cost of supplies to other organisations (other humanitarian activities 15,858k less DNDi's 2,000k and goods sold 11,764k).

lines.label: Relief-item distributions and search and rescue at sea
lines.source: https://www.msf.org/sites/default/files/2026-07/MSF_International_Financial_Report_2025.pdf (2025, euros): relief distributions, 653,300 families (https://www.msf.org/international-activity-report-2025/2025-figures) × our 45 euros a family (MSF doesn't publish the cost), 29,399k, plus search and rescue operations 3,152k (p. 68).

lines.label: Awareness-raising, MSF Access and the DNDi grant
lines.source: https://www.msf.org/sites/default/files/2026-07/MSF_International_Financial_Report_2025.pdf (2025, euros): awareness-raising 57,438k and MSF Access 5,318k (p. 27), contribution to DNDi 2,000k (p. 37).
